name: Spicy Chorizo Pizza
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat, when hot add oil then chorizo; cook while breaking sausage into bite size pieces until no pink remains, 4-5 minutes or until internal temp is 165˚C/74˚C
Sprinkle flour on both sides of the pizza dough and stretch into a rough oval shape on a parchment-lined baking sheet
Spread tomato sauce over dough, tear mozzarella over sauce, top with onions, peppers, chili flakes, and chorizo
Bake pizza on middle rack until golden brown and crisp, 14-18 minutes
To prepare the paprika aioli, stir together paprika, garlic, salt, pepper, half the vinegar, and mayo to a small bowl
When pizza is done, let sit for 2-3 minutes, then cut pizza into slices
Drizzle maple syrup over the top, and sprinkle the chives over pizza
Add extra chili flakes for more spice if desired
Serve pizza with the paprika aioli
